chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Abdullah Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu 'Abdillah (عليه السلام), that he heard him saying:

When Amir al-Mu'minin (عليه السلام) passed away, al-Hasan and al-Husayn and two other men brought him out, until when they had gone out from al-Kufah, they left it on their right. Then they took the way through al-Jabbanah until they passed with him to al-Ghariyy, where they buried him, leveled his grave, and departed.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful; title of Imam 'Ali (عليه السلام)
key_terms.الْجَبَّانَةِ: the cemetery/plain route they took after leaving Kufah
key_terms.الْغَرِيِّ: al-Ghariyy, the place where he was buried
key_terms.الْكُوفَةِ: Kufah, the city from which the funeral party departed
key_terms.قُبِضَ: passed away; a reverential expression for death

ai.seo_question: How was Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali (عليه السلام) buried according to al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates the burial of Amir al-Mu'minin 'Ali (عليه السلام) after his passing. It describes how al-Hasan and al-Husayn (عليهما السلام), along with two other men, carried him from al-Kufah to al-Ghariyy, buried him there, and leveled the grave before returning.

en.hubeali:
Sa’d Bin Abdullah, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Fazzal, from Abdullah Bukeyr, from some of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that he heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying:

‘When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> passed away, Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> and Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> and two other men brought him<sup>asws</sup> out until when they came out from Al-Kufa. They left it (Al-Kufa) upon their right, then they took (the way) of Al-Jabban until they passed with him<sup>asws</sup> to Al-Ghary, so they buried him<sup>asws</sup>, and evened out his<sup>asws</sup> grave, and they left’.
en.sarwar: 11. Sa‘d ibn ‘Abdallah has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from ‘Abdallah ibn Bukaayr from certain persons of our people who has said the following. “He heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘

When Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) died, al-Hassan and al-Husayn and two other man carried his body out until they went out of Kufa. They continued with Kufa on their right and then they moved forwards on the path of Jabana until they passed al-Ghari. They then buried him and leveelled his grave and then return (home).”
